title: 19-BCV-019 - Interior stairways for roof access to HVAC equipment
code_edition: National Building Code – 2019 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)); Alberta Occupational Health and Safety requirements referenced

facts.text: The variance addresses fixed rung ladders or ship’s stairs/fixed industrial stairs for occasional interior roof access to service HVAC equipment.
It sets a maximum 3.7 m vertical height between ship-stair landings and a maximum 3 m ladder height between landing platforms.
Drawings/specifications should show fabrication and installation details and be certified by a professional engineer; Occupational Health and Safety requirements also apply.
